mentions.name: Skyscraper
mentions.description: A native iOS Bluesky client styled after classic Twitter apps like Tweetbot and Twitterrific, built to feel at home on the iPhone with a Liquid Glass UI. Features push notifications, discovery and feed following tools, search, moderation setting management, and post translation. Currently in alpha via TestFlight and open for feedback.
mentions.problem: The standard Bluesky app is functional but lacks the polished, native iPhone feel of classic Twitter clients like Tweetie, Tweetbot, and Twitterrific.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on Skyscraper, which is an iOS native Bluesky client: https://testflight.apple.com/join/RRvk14ks
